propositions: The dc_store_copy_repo fixture calls git fetch with capture_output=True and check=True, which suppresses git stderr and raises CalledProcessError carrying only exit status 128, making the failure undiagnosable.
The git fetch on the critical path is a single un-retried network call, so transient network errors hard-fail the entire DC harness test run without recovery.
The same diagnostic problem (captured stderr with check=True) exists in the git archive and git ls-tree calls within the same fixture.
New helpers run_git and fetch_tickets must capture git output and raise RuntimeError carrying the joined command, exit status, and verbatim stderr on failure.
The fetch helper must retry a bounded number of times (FETCH_ATTEMPTS=3) with backoff before final failure, implementing retry-then-fail policy rather than silent skip.
